purpose: Bounded TXT windows, full-source copying, chapter navigation and next-document UI; not Telari differential or real IME acceptance

results.name: large TXT opens into the bounded reader without constructing a full rich-editor DOM
a distant chapter mounts its source window and Back restores the previous window
native reading Select All copies the entire exact source across unmounted windows
a partial paragraph selection copies only the exact selected source, never the entire virtual document
TXT presets affect only the reader and keep source, edit selection and undo intact
